why.title: A better beginning when customers call.
why.body: We are designing an experience that organizes repeated requests, preserves context, and brings your team's attention where it is needed.

items.q: Is this demo a real phone call?
items.a: No. Conversations, records, and transfers are simulated in the browser. No live telephony is used.

items.q: Do I need to use a microphone?
items.a: No. Every scenario works with text. Recognition and speech synthesis are optional where supported by the browser.

items.q: Can it connect to my systems?
items.a: This release has no live integrations. The architecture anticipates CRM, order, PMS, and telephony connections.
Demo conversations and sample action data stay in the page session. Please do not enter real personal or payment information.
